currentEfficiencyAcceptance.limits: Measured on development host, not evaluation host. Spinner may overshoot rounded LIMIT and spend BANK. Accepted thresholds are runner p95 <=3ms and wall <=300*TURN+5s. Historical measurements/assessments below remain unchanged; C-stage full grading efficiency is untested.

efficiencyAcceptance.method: 80-unit 40x40 engine fixtures: 3x1000 samples after 30 warmup; parse, step, hash, both observations. 3 single games and 6 concurrent games per version, both bots consume at least the calibrated TURN_CPU_MS for 300 turns; all bots/compilers in bwrap.
efficiencyAcceptance.limits: Mean/p95 do not hide >3ms outliers; six-job games exceed 35s. Spinner may overshoot due to clock granularity and parsing, charged to BANK. No threshold changes; evaluation-host reference and full C-stage scoring efficiency remain unavailable. Older curve below is retained historical evidence.

method: Fixed 80,000,000-iteration single-thread integer workload, compiled in bwrap once per invocation. All workers reach READY before GO. Each concurrency has 3 samples. Native process CPU time is measured; all samples and failures are retained.
